caption: The drawing depicts a round ceramic plate, centrally placed against a plain light beige background. The plate features a decorative border with a wavy yellow line along the rim. Inside, there is an illustration of a man and a woman standing side by side; the man is on the left, wearing brown trousers, a brown jacket, and a dark hat, while the woman is on the right, dressed in a greenish dress with a white apron and a brown shawl, and her hair appears to be tied up and adorned with a bow. Their arms are bent, with the man’s arm around the woman’s shoulder. The background of the plate’s center is a muted beige, and around the couple are two large, stylized green and brown flowers with stems and leaves, positioned on opposite sides inside curved brown areas that frame the couple. The plate includes subtle yellow, brown, and green shading. The artist’s signature, “EH Stoll 1933,” appears in the lower right part of the drawing outside the plate.
title: Dish
